title: Video Ads
intro: Zoo 2 offers two types of video ads for mobile app users: Billboard Ads that earn diamonds, and Bonus Offer Ads that provide various bonuses, discounts, or timer reductions. Browser ads are only available in limited regions.
billboard_body: A billboard to the left of the front entrance lets some platforms watch short video ads in exchange for diamonds. Watching 10 ads generates 1 diamond with a maximum availability of 20 ads in a 24-hour period. Ad availability may be limited by region, platform, and other factors.
redeeming_body: You can redeem diamonds as soon as you reach 10 ads. However, saving up 1000 ads before clicking redeem prompts the game to give you a 100-diamond package bonus animal. Saving 2000+ ads earns a pair of premium animals with your 200-diamond redemption. Redeeming 10,000+ ads gives 1000 diamonds and a single VIP animal or other current VIP offer choice. This bonus animal feature is not guaranteed by Upjers, and premature redemptions cannot be reversed.
availability_body: Billboard Ads are limited to 20 per 24-hour period. Each ad starts its own 24-hour timer. Once the daily limit is reached, a timer shows when more ads are available. Devices that allow the app to download from the Google Play Store should generally offer ads.
age_body: The game requests to know the player's age, related to privacy policies for advertisements. Entering an age of 12 or below locks the game on the device with a message claiming the game is not designed for children. Reinstalling the game prompts the question again.
tips_intro: Ad availability most frequently seems related to the ad tracking identity. Important: Currently billboard ads are linked to the bonus offer ads setting — be sure to untick "Don't show video offers" in settings to enable all ad capability including billboard ads.
tip_delay: DELAY: Wait 5 seconds between ads before attempting to watch another.
tip_restart: RESTART: Sometimes simply restarting the game will grant more ad availability.
tip_internet: SWITCH INTERNET: Try connecting to a different internet or use cellular data to see if ads become available.
tip_device: SWITCH DEVICE: Try watching ads on a different device linked with your Support ID.
tip_tracking: RESET TRACKING: For Android, reset Google Ads ID. For iOS, reset by toggling off and on Tracking.
ios_tracking_body: Go to Settings > Privacy & Security > Tracking. Toggle On "Allow Apps to Request to Track", then toggle On "Zoo 2" app. Restart the game. If this is the first time since reinstalling, click the green "Activate" button when you click to watch ads.
ios_reset_body: Go to Settings > Privacy & Security > Tracking. Toggle Off "Allow Apps to Request to Track" and confirm "Ask Ads to Stop Tracking". Then toggle it back On and also toggle On "Zoo 2" app. Restart the game. You may need to repeat this each time ads become unavailable.
android_reset_body: Go to Settings > Google > Ads. Tap "Reset Advertising ID" then OK. Restart the game. You may need to repeat this each time ads become unavailable.
bonus_body: For mobile app platforms, players can enable video bonus offers in the Game Settings by unticking the "Don't show video offers" checkbox. Important: When collecting from admissions booth registers, clicking "don't show video offers" will disable all bonus ads. Bonus offers have their own limit of up to 20 ads every 24 hours.
xp_bonus_body: This feature unlocks 24 hours after previous activation. Currently a configuration issue links this bonus to the billboard ad timer, so some players may need to wait until their billboard ad countdown timer ends. The issue should be fixed in a future update.
xp_sources_body: Cleaning enclosures, playing with animals, feeding animals, completing quests, placing new items or animals, releasing animals, helping friends, watering plants, collecting trash, breeding unsuccessfully, growing up babies, or collecting XP from workers.
fertility_body: This breeding boost can only be applied to active breedings. Ensure you have enough time to completely watch a video before the breeding completes, or the boost will not be applied and the ad will not count toward your limit.
video_chests_body: This feature unlocks 24 hours after previous activation. You must also have enough of your 20 bonus ad limit remaining after the 24-hour waiting period expires.
limits_body: Bonus offer ad limits are separate from your billboard ad limit. Within a given 24-hour period, you can watch up to 20 bonus offer ads. Each ad starts its own 24-hour timer. If you watch an ad but do not complete it, the bonus is not applied and the ad does not count toward your limit.
